text:
A customer messages you at 10 pm. You reply at 10 am.

In those 12 hours, they've asked two or three other businesses. Whoever replied first, with something useful, usually wins.

You don't need to stay awake. You need a better away message.

Most away messages say "We are closed" and nothing else. A useful one:
→ Says exactly when you'll reply ("first thing at 10 am")
→ Sends what they probably wanted anyway: price list, menu, photos of past work
→ Asks one question so you can start the conversation warm in the morning

WhatsApp Business has this built in, for free.

What does your away message say right now?
